title: Kissed Earthy Portuguese Sweet Potatoes Casserole
description: Earthy and comforting Portuguese dish featuring unsweetened cocoa and shio-koji cure, perfect for a dairy-free friendly meal. This casserole combines the natural sweetness of sweet potatoes with the depth of earthy flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix together the unsweetened cocoa powder, shio-koji cure, and nutritional yeast.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl with the cocoa mixture and stir until well combined.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of sweet potatoes.
Spread half of the cocoa mixture over the sweet potatoes.
Repeat the layers, starting with the sweet potatoes, then the remaining cocoa mixture, and finally another layer of sweet potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the top is lightly browned.
